# Vendored CEP runtime

This directory contains the production dependencies resolved by the root
`package-lock.json` for `cep-promise` 4.4.1. Keeping them beside the packaged
`cep_service.js` lets Node resolve its normal module imports from an installed
wheel, without running npm or accessing a package registry at runtime.

The vendored package licenses and package metadata are retained. Refresh this
tree from a clean `npm ci` production installation whenever the root npm
manifest or lockfile changes; do not add development dependencies or run
lifecycle scripts.

The npm tr46 0.0.3 archive omitted its license file. Its `LICENSE.md` is copied
verbatim from upstream commit 3a6f29721e7063b9ffd421e461a54beae6170001, the
immediate successor of the 0.0.3 release commit that adds the MIT license.

Minor cleanup deferred: browser bundles, source maps, and documentation are
retained verbatim rather than pruned without validated size or runtime benefit.
